verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that anyone can publish and consume providers, modules, and policies on the public Terraform Registry, which offers search and tier filtering, and modules are documented as reusable configurations. Community complaints that some public modules are poor quality confirm the ecosystem exists and is used, but they are about module content, not the capability. Missing for 10: documented module publishing workflow details (repo/versioning requirements), explicit evidence of module source/version consumption syntax and auto-download for modules (only providers are evidenced)
